entities.summary: Evan Amos is a photographer of video game consoles, which he licenses freely to the public domain. He contributes these images to Wikipedia, and as of 2015 works on The Vanamo Online Game Museum, a free digital archive of video game hardware. As of 2018, he resides in Brooklyn, New York City.
